name: Cerebras
description: Cerebras builds wafer-scale AI hardware and offers a cloud inference service that delivers some of the fastest token-generation rates publicly available. Cerebras Inference (2024) and pay-per-token (2025 GA) brought hosted access to Llama and Qwen variants on dedicated CS-3 systems.
pricingDetails: Free: 1M tokens/day. Pay-per-token from $10 deposit. Code Pro: $50/month. Code Max: $200/month. Tokens: $0.60-$3.90/M.
